screens: Agent builder (basics, persona, job and facts, objections and hand-off, tools, voice stack, versions)
Voice stack picker (no default, graded figures)
Docked test panel (practice callers, browser call)
Contacts (people, audiences, import wizard with column mapping and per-row verdicts)
Campaign create (category first, window, pace, cap, estimate)
Campaign page (launch checklist, live meters, funnel, window change)
Call page (two-lane waveform with pins, synced transcript in 3 views, quotes, outcome, explain, compliance trace, cost)
Settings (team, API keys, brand, knowledge, billing, compliance, privacy, operator, activity)
Operator dock on every page (SSE client, plan/approval/receipt cards, hold-to-confirm)
works: Runs on the REAL tools: every name the UI calls is registered (ui-contract --strict: 78 of 78), checked by tests/web.test.ts

Seen against the real server (all modules, real Postgres) with data made through the real tools: sign up, template agents, stack.set, publish, a synthetic CSV through source.upload/map/commit, audiences, campaign drafts, knowledge, and four calls reported through the signed runtime hook (web/dev/seed.ts)

Operator dock speaks the real SSE contract (threads, messages, delta/step/card/notice/done); plan, approval and receipt cards render; approvals hold 1.2 s (or two presses) then POST /v1/actions/:id/decide

Agent builder saves with brief.edit (leaf-level set ops, server-validated, errors shown with their field), stack.set for the voice stack, version.publish bound to the draft hash; practice callers run test.simulate with six inline callers
Import wizard: source.upload, source.map (columns, per-row verdicts, re-map by override), source.commit with an optional recorded-consent purpose
Campaign page shows the server's launch blockers as the checklist, campaign.estimate (computed, incl. GST), campaign.funnel; window changes use window.narrow (at once) or window.widen (A2)
Call page draws who spoke when from turn timing, the words, moments, safety events, outcome grades (verified, manager, AI guess), call.explain, cost lines
Today uses the real brief.today; Settings covers team, keys, brand, knowledge passages, wallet and usage, compliance rules, memory policy, operator, integrations, activity
Colour tokens pass 5:1 in light and dark; screenshots of every screen at 390x844 and 1440x900 in web/shots/ with no horizontal scroll and no console errors in the real-server run

Browser flows (web/e2e, Playwright against the real server and a fresh database; skip with a message when there is no Chromium or Postgres): API key create, approve, reveal once, second reveal refused; learning propose, simulate, accept card; DPDP erase; A3 pause and stop with no card, resume as an A2 card; an A2 card from the Operator chat. Each asserts the screen and the server. They found and fixed two real bugs: the secret came back as `token` not `secret`, and a confirmed approval sheet hid what it produced

Numbers page uses number.list and the spoken-code phone verification; practice callers come from simcaller.list; an inconclusive trap is shown as inconclusive, not as an agent failure; a refused browser call shows the server's reason word for word (7 and 8 of 8 e2e flows)
untested: Calls were seeded through the runtime hook because the sandbox has no telephony and the fake model gives no outcomes or analysis; no real call, number rental, KYC, payment or WhatsApp was exercised
The call page has no audio playback and no waveform: the server stores no peaks, so lanes are drawn from turn timing
Fonts: Anek and Fraunces are named first with Inter/Noto fallbacks; no font files are shipped, so the type specimen gate has not run
Dark theme checked by contrast numbers only; no real-device, screen-reader, touch, speech-input or Lighthouse run
Browser audio: test.browser_call now prepares a draft session (tied to the draft hash) and the page says so, but no audio transport exists, so nothing is heard
Practice callers use the server's library (simcaller.list) but ran against the scripted fake model, so most fail their checks; the UI path is real, the verdicts mean nothing

Phone verification (member.phone.verify_start and verify_confirm) and number rental are wired but not run: a sandbox has no telephony to ring. The e2e fixture left in SQL is only a campaign set to running (launch needs a rented line)
needs_from_others: voice: sample clips per stack, a browser-call transport, per-call recording and waveform peaks; until then the picker says 'No sample recorded yet' and the call page draws turn timing
calls: per-turn translations (romanised, English) if the three-view transcript is wanted; today the server stores the text as heard only
money: per-stack price is shown from money.estimate as provider cost per connected minute, grade computed; no customer price exists, and the pages say so
design: Anek and Fraunces woff2 files (self-hosted, Latin and Devanagari, under 100 KB)
operator: operator.brain.set stores a choice that the LLM door ignores (their note)

dev.run: eval $(sh product/scripts/pg-test.sh vp_web_real); export VP_SECRET_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32) VP_RUNTIME_SECRET=rt-$(openssl rand -hex 24); node product/web/build.mjs; PORT=8788 VP_LLM_FAKE=1 node --import tsx product/server/main.ts   (or product/web/dev/serve.ts for a scripted Operator model)
dev.note: There is no mock any more: web/dev/serve.ts differs from server/main.ts only by scripting the Operator's model
